verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is API-first. Model inference, model catalog listing (GET /api/v1/models), programmatic API key management and per-request data-policy and provider routing are all available through the API, and a public OpenAPI spec exists. The evidence never claims full UI/API parity, though, and several UI-side controls have no documented API equivalent: the account settings page for training-data routing, workspace budgets, BYOK configuration and usage analytics. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API endpoints for workspace budgets, account privacy settings, BYOK setup and analytics/usage data, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Browse the full catalog at openrouter.ai/models, or list every available slug programmatically via the GET /api/v1/models endpoint.
OpenRouter provides endpoints to programmatically manage your API keys, enabling key creation and management for applications that need to distribute or rotate keys automatically.
You can restrict individual requests to only use providers with a certain data policy. This is also available as an account-wide setting in your privacy settings.
